option_relations.rationale: Idiopathic hypertrophic pachymeningitis is a rare condition characterized by inflammation of the dura mater, which matches the leaf label for B1.3.
Granulomatous Meningoencephalitis of Unknown Etiology is a condition that matches the leaf label for B1.2, which is a type of inflammatory meningoencephalitis.
Chronic meningitis is a broader term that encompasses various types of meningitis, including those caused by infectious agents, which is related to the leaf label for B1.4.
Rheumatoid meningitis is a condition that matches the leaf label for B1.1, which is a type of inflammatory meningitis associated with rheumatoid arthritis.
